name: graveyard
label: Kakariko Graveyard
about: Pieces and textures cut from Kakariko Graveyard (spot02). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where spot02 draws them). Room 1 is the graveyard: `ground` its grass camo, `cliff` the dirt walls round it (a grass lip at the top), `grass_band` the bushy band above them, `flagstones` the translucent paving of the grave rows, `fence` the rope fences, `palisade` the plank walls by the gate. Room 0 is the cave to the Shadow Temple: `dirt` its floor, `cave_rock` its walls, `cave_ceiling` its roof, `shadow_brick` the temple's blue brick, `steps` the ramp down into it, `emblem` the Sheikah eye on its floor. Dampé's hut is `hut_wall`, `roof_planks`, `stove`, `chimney`.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong. Dampé's doorway floor carries its exit: it collides as a door.

pieces.name: gy_dampe_hut
pieces.label: Dampé's hut
pieces.about: The gravekeeper's plank hut in spot02's south-west corner, with a lean-to porch over a stove and its chimney on the east, by the door.

pieces.name: gy_entrance_gate
pieces.label: Graveyard gate
pieces.about: The gateway from Kakariko: two pairs of wooden posts with a crossbeam and a name board, hung with vines. 200 tall, 280 between the posts.

pieces.name: gy_gravestone
pieces.label: Gravestone
pieces.about: The wide inscribed tablet by Dampé's hut (68 tall), the one gravestone drawn as scene geometry; the rows' gravestones are actors.

pieces.name: gy_royal_tablet
pieces.label: Royal tomb tablet
pieces.about: A low stone block with the royal crest carved on its sloping top, one of the pair either side of the Royal Family's tomb (its gravestone is an actor).

pieces.name: gy_shadow_dais
pieces.label: Shadow Temple dais
pieces.about: The Sheikah eye painted on the floor before the Shadow Temple (translucent, 437 across) with the low pedestal in its middle, 24 tall. Its ring of torches are actors.
